feature_preprocessing: SEC-GFD raw feature pathway; no PMP row normalization
environment_loss_indexing: corrected to use actual global training-node IDs
environment_loss_similarity: exp(cosine_similarity) before class-wise averaging, matching SEC-GFD paper environmental loss
official_code_high_order_note: Released SEC-GFD main.py uses high_order=2; preserved here.
hyperparameter_source: FDCompCN SEC-GFD configuration selected by the predefined validation-only hyperparameter search. Search space: hidden_dim in {16, 64} and order_C in {2, 5}; all configurations evaluated on train_40 using the five predefined benchmark seeds and selected by mean validation AUROC. Selected hidden_dim=64 and order_C=2; mean validation AUROC=0.629646 with std=0.026207. The test set was not accessed during tuning. Learning rate=0.01, weight decay=0.0, lambda_env=0.2, Adam optimizer, and high_order=2 were kept fixed from SEC-GFD paper/released-code settings.
benchmark_stopping_note: Unified benchmark uses max 500 epochs and patience 25 instead of SEC-GFD paper's fixed 100 epochs.
timing_note: train_time_seconds excludes epoch-level recovery-checkpoint disk I/O.
reproducibility_note: Python, NumPy, PyTorch and DGL seeds are fixed and PyTorch deterministic algorithms are enabled. Diagnostic testing confirmed identical model initialization for a fixed seed, but DGL CUDA sparse message-passing produced small numerical differences across repeated forward passes with identical parameters and inputs. Therefore CUDA execution is not bitwise deterministic and results are summarized across the five predefined benchmark seeds.
